notes: ChatGPT connector metadata is scoped to reviewed invoices, expenses, clients/CRM, products, quotes, vendors, and current business context/current-month totals. Selected client contacts and client notes can be permanently deleted after explicit confirmation. A quote draft is eligible for permanent deletion only when it has no delivery, response, attachment, or conversion evidence; a protected draft is refused, while deleting a non-draft quote cancels it. Raw documents, webhook administration, hidden product modules, dedicated regulated-identifier fields, credentials, and diagnostic metadata are excluded; ten confirmed writes may still deliver business events to endpoints previously configured by the workspace owner.

releases.notes: OpenAI mode exposes 33 reviewed business tools plus 3 read-only discovery meta-tools. Selected client contacts and client notes can be permanently deleted after explicit confirmation. A quote draft is eligible for permanent deletion only when it has no delivery, response, attachment, or conversion evidence; a protected draft is refused, while deleting a non-draft quote cancels it. Direct email delivery, the legacy monthly summary, update of existing quotes, incomplete client-parent or expense-attachment deletion, product or vendor deletion, prompts, raw documents, invoice lifecycle/credit tools, webhook administration, and hidden full-server modules are not part of this surface; ten confirmed writes may still deliver business events to endpoints previously configured by the workspace owner.
